definitions.explanation: The various tasks involved in maintaining a household, such as cooking, cleaning, laundry, and other domestic duties.

examples.japanese: {家事|かじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手伝|てつだ}う→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧。
⟦{夫婦|ふうふ}→夫婦：03592_fuufu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{家事|かじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分担|ぶんたん}→分担：11771_buntan⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{育児|いくじ}→育児：03998_ikuji⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{家事|かじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{両立|りょうりつ}→両立：11310_ryouritsu⟧⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: Balancing work, childcare, and housework is not easy.

notes:
{家事|かじ} combines ⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧ (house, home) and {事|じ} (matter, task).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {家事|かじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to do housework)
- {家事|かじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手伝|てつだ}う→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧ (to help with housework)
- {家事|かじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分担|ぶんたん}→分担：11771_buntan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to share housework)
- {家事|かじ}⟦{代行|だいこう}→代行：11433_daikou⟧ (housekeeping service)
- {家事|かじ}⟦{育児|いくじ}→育児：03998_ikuji⟧ (housework and childcare)

USAGE:
{家事|かじ} is the standard word for housework in general. It encompasses ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧ (cooking), ⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧ (cleaning), ⟦{洗濯|せんたく}→洗濯：13283_sentaku⟧ (laundry), and other domestic tasks. Note the homophone ⟦{火事|かじ}→火事：01283_kaji⟧ (fire, conflagration), which has completely different kanji and meaning.
